findings.highlight: I want to Sakura to live—I want to live with Sakura.
findings.evidenceJa: 桜を—桜と一緒に、生きていきたい。
findings.governingReading: Broken Sakura object gives way to explicit desire to live together with her.
findings.explanation: Want to Sakura to live is malformed.

findings.highlight: Last time, I showed you how to see far away with magecraft, but this time, it'll be really amazing!
findings.evidenceJa: 前に見せた魔術の応用だけど、今度のはすごいんだよ。
findings.governingReading: She says the new act is an application of magecraft/far-seeing shown before, though this time impressive.
findings.explanation: New miracle's application of earlier far-seeing magecraft omitted.

findings.governingReading: Source spoken fragment begins and ends in dialogue brackets.
findings.explanation: Broken name call has closing quote without opening quote.

findings.highlight: For just a moment, I lift my arm up and reach into the sky.
findings.evidenceJa: ほんの少し、ただ腕を伸ばすだけで、空へ抜ける。
findings.governingReading: Sky is just a little farther, reachable merely by extending arm, before he realizes there is no power left and sinks.
findings.explanation: Small remaining reach to sky becomes momentary enacted arm lift.

findings.highlight: It's completely useless, but the small, small pendant will make sure that someone saves me if I reach out with my hand.
findings.evidenceJa: 何の役にも立たない、けれど、手を伸ばすぐらいは助けてくれる、小さな小さなペンダント。
findings.governingReading: Tiny pendant has just one breath of mana; insufficient for much, but helps him extend his hand.
findings.explanation: Pendant enabling hand extension becomes guarantee of external rescue conditional on reach.
